title: A set satisfying the two-point cone condition lies in a closed Lipschitz graph over v^⊥ (Simon Ch. 3, 1.6 ⇐, graph step; McShane extension)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, E := ℝ^{m+1}, v ∈ E with |v| = 1, and S ⊆ E such that |⟨x′ − x, v⟩| ≤ ½|x′ − x| for all x, x′ ∈ S. Then there is a closed countably m-rectifiable set Γ ⊆ E with S ⊆ Γ.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1)) (S : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ x' ∈ S, |inner ℝ (x' - x) v| ≤ ‖x' - x‖ / 2) → ∃ Γ : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsClosed Γ ∧ CountablyRectifiable m Γ ∧ S ⊆ Γ
